```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FILE: vignettes/plot-controls.Rmd
# FULL WORKING — VIGNETTE SHOWS PLOTS (Scenario 1 & 2)
#
# GOAL (this iteration):
# - Make EVERY embedded saved PNG render at the SAME on-page size
#   (matching your "good size" example)                       #$$$$$$$$$$$$$
#
# HOW:
# - Set a global fixed display width for ALL embedded images:  #$$$$$$$$$$$$$
#     knitr::opts_chunk$set(out.width = "900px", fig.align="center")
# - Also set out.width inside the include helper (so even if chunk
#   options change later, saved-plot embeds stay uniform).      #$$$$$$$$$$$$$
#
# ROOT CAUSE of prior "images found but not shown":
# - include_graphics() must be returned/printed by the chunk.
#   We already fixed that by returning include_graphics().
#
# We keep the "vignette asset shipping" fix:
# - Output root forced under knitr's fig.path so PNGs ship with HTML.
# ============================================================

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  fig.align = "center",     #$$$$$$$$$$$$$ FIX: center all figures/embeds
  out.width = "900px"       #$$$$$$$$$$$$$ FIX: uniform on-page image size
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Load package (installed OR from source via devtools)
# ----------------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("DDESONN", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
    devtools::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)
  } else {
    stop(
      "DDESONN is not installed and devtools is unavailable.\n",
      "Install the package or install devtools to knit from source."
    )
  }
}

library(DDESONN)
set.seed(111)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------------------------------------
.print_core_metrics <- function(res, label = "RUN") {
  cat("\n\n====================================================================\n")
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat("====================================================================\n\n")

  if (!is.null(res$train_metrics)) {
    cat("== Train metrics ==\n")
    print(res$train_metrics)
    cat("\n")
  }

  if (!is.null(res$validation_metrics)) {
    cat("== Validation metrics ==\n")
    print(res$validation_metrics)
    cat("\n")
  }

  if (!is.null(res$test_metrics)) {
    cat("== Test metrics ==\n")
    print(res$test_metrics)
    cat("\n")
  }

  if (!is.null(res$final_training) &&
      !is.null(res$final_training$predicted_outputAndTime)) {
    cat("== Final training summary (predicted_outputAndTime) ==\n")
    print(res$final_training$predicted_outputAndTime)
    cat("\n")
  }

  if (!is.null(res$final_summary_lines)) {
    cat("== Final summary (preformatted) ==\n")
    cat(paste(res$final_summary_lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
  }
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# VIGNETTE FIX: write plot outputs under knitr's fig.path
# ----------------------------------------------------------
.vignette_fig_root <- function(subdir) {
  # Base where the knitted HTML is written (base for relative links)
  od <- knitr::opts_knit$get("output.dir")
  if (is.null(od) || !nzchar(od)) od <- getwd()

  # knitr figure path (relative), e.g. "plot-controls_files/figure-html/"
  fp_rel <- knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path")
  if (is.null(fp_rel) || !nzchar(fp_rel)) fp_rel <- "figure/"

  # Absolute folder where knitr expects figures to live for this vignette
  fp_abs <- file.path(od, fp_rel)
  dir.create(fp_abs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Dedicated subdir under fig.path so it ships with vignette assets
  p <- file.path(fp_abs, subdir)
  dir.create(p, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  p
}

.include_saved_plots <- function(output_root, max_n = 200L) {
  if (is.null(output_root) || !dir.exists(output_root)) {
    cat("\n(no plot output_root found)\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  imgs <- list.files(
    output_root,
    pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
  imgs <- sort(imgs)

  cat("\n[include_saved_plots] output_root:\n",
      tryCatch(normalizePath(output_root, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) output_root),
      "\n", sep = "")
  cat("[include_saved_plots] found images:\n")
  print(imgs)

  if (!length(imgs)) {
    cat("\n(no saved plot images found)\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  sizes <- file.info(imgs)$size
  ok <- is.finite(sizes) & sizes > 0
  imgs_ok <- imgs[ok]

  if (!length(imgs_ok)) {
    cat("\n(found images but all are empty size=0)\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Make paths relative to output.dir for embedding into the HTML
  od <- knitr::opts_knit$get("output.dir")
  if (is.null(od) || !nzchar(od)) od <- getwd()

  base_path <- normalizePath(od, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  imgs_ok_rel <- sub(paste0("^", base_path, "/?"), "", normalizePath(imgs_ok, winslash = "/"))

  cat("[DEBUG] Relative paths for include_graphics:\n")
  print(utils::head(imgs_ok_rel, max_n))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # #$$$$$$$$$$$$$ DISPLAY SIZE FIX:
  # Force uniform on-page size for ALL saved PNG embeds.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  old_out_width <- knitr::opts_current$get("out.width")
  old_align <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.align")
  knitr::opts_current$set(out.width = "900px", fig.align = "center")  #$$$$$$$$$$$$$
  on.exit(knitr::opts_current$set(out.width = old_out_width, fig.align = old_align), add = TRUE)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # CRITICAL RENDER FIX:
  # RETURN include_graphics() so knitr emits the <img> tags.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  knitr::include_graphics(utils::head(imgs_ok_rel, max_n))
}
```

## Load example data from `inst/extdata`

```{r data}
ext_dir <- system.file("extdata", package = "DDESONN")
if (!nzchar(ext_dir)) stop("Could not find DDESONN extdata folder.", call. = FALSE)

hf_path <- file.path(ext_dir, "heart_failure_clinical_records.csv")
if (!file.exists(hf_path)) stop("heart_failure_clinical_records.csv not found.", call. = FALSE)

df <- read.csv(hf_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

y <- as.numeric(df$DEATH_EVENT)
x <- as.matrix(df[, setdiff(names(df), "DEATH_EVENT")])

n <- nrow(x)
idx <- sample(seq_len(n))
n_train <- floor(0.7 * n)
n_valid <- floor(0.15 * n)

x_train <- x[idx[1:n_train], , drop = FALSE]
y_train <- y[idx[1:n_train]]

x_valid <- x[idx[(n_train + 1):(n_train + n_valid)], , drop = FALSE]
y_valid <- y[idx[(n_train + 1):(n_train + n_valid)]]

x_test  <- x[idx[(n_train + n_valid + 1):n], , drop = FALSE]
y_test  <- y[idx[(n_train + n_valid + 1):n]]
```

## Scenario 1 — `training_overrides`

```{r scenario1}
out1 <- .vignette_fig_root("DDESONN_plots_s1")

options(DDESONN_OUTPUT_ROOT = out1)
Sys.setenv(DDESONN_ARTIFACTS_ROOT = out1)

res_s1 <- ddesonn_run(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  classification_mode = "binary",
  seeds = 1,
  validation = list(x = x_valid, y = y_valid),
  test = list(x = x_test, y = y_test),
  training_overrides = list(
    validation_metrics = TRUE,
    per_epoch_view_plots = list(
      accuracy_plot = TRUE,
      saturation_plot = TRUE,
      max_weight_plot = TRUE
    )
  )
)

.print_core_metrics(res_s1, "SCENARIO 1")

# MUST be the last expression in the chunk (it is), so plots render
.include_saved_plots(ddesonn_plots_dir(out1))
```

## Scenario 2 — `plot_controls`

```{r scenario2}
out2 <- .vignette_fig_root("DDESONN_plots_s2")

options(DDESONN_OUTPUT_ROOT = out2)
Sys.setenv(DDESONN_ARTIFACTS_ROOT = out2)

res_s2 <- ddesonn_run(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  classification_mode = "binary",
  seeds = 1,
  validation = list(x = x_valid, y = y_valid),
  test = list(x = x_test, y = y_test),
  plot_controls = list(
    per_epoch = list(
      accuracy_plot = TRUE,
      saturation_plot = TRUE,
      max_weight_plot = TRUE
    )
  ),
  training_overrides = list(validation_metrics = TRUE)
)

.print_core_metrics(res_s2, "SCENARIO 2")

# MUST be the last expression in the chunk (it is), so plots render
.include_saved_plots(ddesonn_plots_dir(out2))
```
